analysis.reasonEn: RSI exited oversold but remains neutral at 41.5. MACD histogram worsened from -0.4445 to -2.3867, indicating continued selling pressure. ADX at 17.4 shows weak trend formation, and volume at 0.94x 5-day average lacks conviction. Current price at 66.8% of 52-week range indicates a pullback. 4H RSI at 35.5 remains oversold. Overall, lack of directional momentum and persistent weak momentum warrant a wait-and-see approach.
